summary: Contemplation builds structured mutation_pr_plan (branch/base/gh_argv/git_steps) and dry-run apply_mutation_pr_plan by default; high-risk live apply needs allow_high_risk + injectable runner (#929/#364).
migration_impact: contemplate() gains mutation_pr_plan + mutation_pr_apply (always dry_run). New pure helpers build_mutation_pr_plan / apply_mutation_pr_plan. No default git push or gh pr create.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull release after merge; run pytest tests/test_contemplation.py -k mutation_pr.
2. Agents execute plan.git_steps / plan.gh_argv on a worktree, or supply runner to apply_mutation_pr_plan(dry_run=False).
3. High-risk paths (AGENTS.md/SPEC/workflows) require allow_high_risk=True after human review.
4. Residual #364: live auto-push without runner still intentionally unsupported.
agent_notes: Closes #929 only. Safe-by-default dry-run during contemplate; never opens live PRs without explicit runner.
